lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill region. Approximately five horizontal rows are visible, with clusters roughly aligned in vertical columns across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal carinae. High-intensity spots are consistently positioned at these intersections, forming a regular grid of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with light-toned pixels on the dorsal edge and shadowed, lower-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin. These spots are significantly smaller and less regularly spaced than those on the primary flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of white linear marks and potential tissue loss (nicks) are visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. A prominent white linear mark is also visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of very small, high-luminance spots along its anterior leading edge, which transitions to larger, more widely spaced spots towards the fin base.
